notes: ACCESS: ampm.fr fully redirects through Cloudflare-protected www.laredoute.fr (AM.PM is a La Redoute brand shop-in-shop under category id 85201, served at laredoute.fr/pplp/cat-85201.aspx). Tier (a) direct HTTP (requests + curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124) got a 403 Cloudflare Turnstile challenge page every time on both the homepage and robots.txt. Tier (b) Playwright bundled Chromium (headless, then headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled) also stalled on the 'Just a moment...' challenge. Escalated within tier (b) to Playwright driving the real installed Chrome via channel='chrome', which consistently passed the challenge (roughly 3 of 4 navigations succeeded on the first try, the rest needed a retry within the same tier, up to 4 attempts, no sleep/poll beyond short in-page waits). robots.txt itself sat behind the same Cloudflare challenge and could not be read as static text; nothing that did render named anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot with a disallow, so tier (b) was not itself blocked by robots. ampm.fr/sitemap.xml redirects straight to the AM.PM homepage - this shop-in-shop brand has no separate XML sitemap, so the tree is the union of the mega-menu (Nouveautes, Canape/fauteuil, Table/chaise, Lit/literie, Meuble, Linge de maison, Luminaire, Decoration, Art de la table, Jardin) and each category's own sub-navigation chips, drilled to leaf level. TREE: h1/breadcrumb was read from the full post-hydration inner_text of every page and confirmed to match the requested node (breadcrumb chain e.g. AM.PM > Linge de maison > Linge de lit > Housse de couette) before recording it; grouping rows were only kept where the site's own breadcrumb/nav placed real children under them. QTY: the exact integer shown directly under the H1 on each category listing page, read after JS hydration (e.g. 'Housse de couette AM.PM' / 46). Cross-checked additivity confirms the reads: Linge de lit's 4 children + Couette,oreiller = 46+46+27+15+2 = 136 = parent Linge de lit total; Linge de maison's 6 direct children sum to exactly 292 = parent total; Rangement deco's 2 children = 51+27 = 78 = parent total. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Canape,fauteuil and Table,chaise (Furniture); the whole Meuble branch - Armoire/commode/dressing, Bibliotheque/etagere, Meuble modulable, Meuble TV/buffet/vaisselier, Console, Bureau (all explicitly under the Meuble/Furniture nav branch, so Furniture per storage.md Sec21/textile.md furniture boundary, not this task); Lit, Tete de lit, Chevet under Lit,literie (bed frame/headboard/nightstand = Furniture); Luminaire and Luminaire exterieur (Lighting); Art de la table (Kitchen & Dining); Objet de decoration and its children (Objet decoratif, Decoration murale, Cache-pot/vase, Bougie/bougeoir/lanterne), and Miroir (Decorative Home Accessories/Wall Decor, out of scope); Decoration exterieure - a 13-item mixed outdoor-decor bucket (first item seen was an outdoor rug but the node itself is a general outdoor decoration catch-all, not a dedicated textile or storage category, so left out per the mixed-purpose caution in textile.md Sec15); Jardin's furniture subcats Salon de jardin, Table de jardin, Chaise/fauteuil de jardin (Furniture); Nouveautes, Collection canapes, Collection linge de maison, Collection outdoor, Votre canape/votre creation, Table a composer (collection/customizer landing pages, excluded per rule 27/35, no exact-qty listing page).
